Project Role: Sr. Software Engineer. 
Project: - Warehouse System. 
Client: - Worldwide Flight Services. 
Project Description: - 
In this project cargo related products are managed by warehouse staff. There are 3  modules, acceptance 
breakdown and buildup. 
The buildup is done by warehouse agents, who need to previously load the records in the system to ensure 
anything built up is OK to go by all standards. Warehouse agents in the smart warehouse to perform the 
breakdown accordingly. Warehouse personnel will then initiate the process of handling the freight 
according to the breakdown instructions prepared by the office  agents during flight preparation. When 
consolidations (with multiple HWBs) are indicated to be broken down by HWB, the warehouse agent 
will enter the piece count at each location for each HWB.
